Card Q&A.a: This effect triggers and can be activated when a Digimon specified by it leaves the battle area under the specified conditions.When activated, all Digimon matching its trigger conditions are prevented from leaving.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's [All Turns] effect do, exactly?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[All Turns] When any of your Digimon with the [CS] trait would leave the battle area, by suspending this Tamer and trashing 2 same-level cards from 1 of your [CS] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, they don't leave.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
